result.stdout:
dotnet prostir — connect this computer to Prostir and run tasks here

  dotnet prostir                     Start in this folder. The first time, your browser opens so you can sign in.
  dotnet prostir <code>              Connect with the one-line command from the worker page, then start.
  dotnet prostir --workspace <path>  Start in another folder.
  dotnet prostir logout              Disconnect this computer.
  dotnet prostir doctor              Check the credential store and the coding tools found here.
  dotnet prostir --version           Show the version.

Advanced:
  dotnet prostir --credential-stdin  Start with a Worker credential piped in (servers and CI). PROSTIR_WORKER_CREDENTIAL works too.
  dotnet prostir <code> --session-only  Connect without saving the connection on this computer.
  dotnet prostir config import       Pipe local provider settings (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX, Copilot) as JSON.
  dotnet prostir mcp login|install --client codex|claude|gemini|proxy

Update: dotnet tool update --global ManagedCode.Prostir.Cli
